sample_unit: patients (top and bottom 200 ranked from an 8000-patient held-out dataset)
models_evaluated: concept classifiers with multistep ranking algorithm (NLP and machine learning)
unlisted_practices: Combining predictions from classifiers for common symptoms and related conditions to pre-screen for a rare disease when no training cases exist
Manual clinician review of top- and bottom-ranked patients to validate a rare-disease screening ranker

screen.reason: The study develops and retrospectively evaluates an NLP and machine-learning phenotyping pipeline to flag potential cases of a rare disease from EHR data, evaluated by clinician chart review.
